issues.issue: The label names the source: annexation compensation, normally paid by the annexing city for lost service territory or customers. 'intergovernmental/state aid' (county/other local governments) or 'charges for services/fees' fits better than 'other'. Already marked review.

Printed as a negative in other revenue (expense), and shown as an outflow in the p4 cash flow statement (capital and related financing). It is effectively an expense, so it could be a 13,965 disbursement instead of a negative receipt. Totals and the roll-forward hold either way.
